title: Health and Wellness App Retention Benchmarks (2026)
meta_description: Health and wellness app retention benchmarks for day 1, 7 and 30, the January cohort problem, and the store-conversion figures for the category.
h1: Health and wellness app retention benchmarks

visuals.caption: Health and wellness retention benchmarks, each row sourced. Verified 30 September 2026.

faq.q: What is a good day 30 retention rate for a health app?
faq.a: The median is 5% at day 30 with strong performers at 8% to 12%, against a 4% cross-industry average. Day 1 is unusually strong at 25% median, rising to 35% to 45% for strong performers.

faq.q: Why do health apps lose users so fast after a strong start?
faq.a: Because intent at install is high and the behaviour it requires is daily and effortful. The gap between a 25% day-1 median and a 5% day-30 median is the distance between deciding to change and doing it repeatedly.

faq.q: Does the January cohort distort health app benchmarks?
faq.a: Materially, and no published benchmark separates it. A January cohort installs with higher intent and churns harder, so a year-round median blends two different populations. Read your own cohorts by month before comparing to any table.

unique_value_statement: Names the seasonal-cohort distortion no published health retention benchmark separates, and pairs the curve with the category's unusually strong store-conversion figures to show that the constraint is behaviour rather than acquisition.
